testingFunctionality: Dashboard loads within 3 seconds on first visit
expectedResult: Page is interactive within 3 seconds
verificationMethod: Automated (Playwright) — measured actual elapsed time from navigation to the greeting heading becoming visible. Dev server (npm run dev): 5.9s and 6.5s on two separate runs. Production build (npm run build + preview): 7.5s. Consistently 2-2.5x over budget in both modes — not a dev-server-overhead artifact. Likely cause: the student dashboard's per-club membership-count computation issues one Firestore query per club (11+ clubs in current seed data) instead of a single batched query.
